then.say: Ah! Don't. I'm only the clerk. Fennick. Clerk of Receipts. I write down what comes in.
Carts come in. Tallow goes out. The numbers balance. They always balance. That's what worries me.

do.say: The ledger says 'raw material'. Twelve carts a week. By weight. Every one of them wearing a pilgrim's robe.
I didn't ask. A clerk doesn't ask. A clerk writes it down neatly.
Someone has to keep the accounts. If I stop, it will all have happened without anyone writing it down.

then.say: The furnaces are cooling. I've drawn a line under the last page. Somebody ought to read it.

else.say: Close the door behind you. Quietly. She listens for doors.
